scientific_scope_status: The unknown Hermitian A satisfies I<=A<=2I on a known finite-dimensional active space with known seed v; a known reference Omega is orthogonal to it. At a classically chosen tau in [0,beta], a source returns a fresh pure state Psi_A(tau)=(Omega+exp(-tau A/2)v)/sqrt(1+F_A(tau)), F_A(z)=<v,exp(-zA)v>. These are not Gibbs states. All requested/discarded/postselected copies count against a fixed worst-case budget. Adaptive classical times, quantum memory and collective measurements are allowed; computation is unlimited. A entries, arbitrary-input imaginary-time propagation and real-time access are absent. Estimating g_A(t)=F_A(it) to additive 1/4 with success 2/3 uniformly over dimensions has proposed minimax log Q(t,beta)=Theta(t log(2+t/beta)), with t/infinity=0. The exponent order is matching, not an exact leading minimax constant or efficient upper algorithm.
